verdict.rationale: The evidence shows official client SDKs in seven languages (Python, TypeScript, C#, Go, Java, PHP, Ruby) with idiomatic interfaces, plus an `ant` CLI. A developer likely has a path to a first call in their language. However, nothing in the pack documents a quickstart guide, runnable sample code, or how quickly a first call can be made. Missing for 10: a documented quickstart page, runnable copy-paste code samples per language, evidence of minutes-to-first-call (API key setup flow), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the onboarding experience.
